reuse.why: Adds one isHoliday predicate and uses it in isSkippedDay and both server/schedules/app.ts daily paths; those app.ts paths still spell out `isWeekend || isHoliday` instead of reusing the existing isSkippedDay.

duplication.why: The holiday matching is defined once; only the pre-existing weekend-or-holiday combination remains repeated in app.ts.

placement.why: The predicate lives in shared/schedules.ts next to isSkippedDay and getDateWithSkippedWeekend, where the tree keeps schedule date rules.

scope.why: Only the holiday checks and focused tests change.

maintainability.why: Small exported predicate that every holiday check now uses; minor nits are the out-of-order import and leftover indentation in the app.ts ternaries.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All holiday checks now go through isHoliday; app.ts not using isSkippedDay predates the change (it was not exported).

disguised_duplication.where: The three previous inline `holidays.includes(dayFromDate(...))` checks were replaced by calls to the one predicate.
